name: The Phoenix
note: Polygons in the rest pose (A1) pixels. The graphic-novel style of the last tables (the Astronaut's sheets the style images). The Pyre's one opponent, heads up; drawn facing right and mirrored as the seat needs. Its wings are its forearms. The master is the rest pose's OWN head. Every pose but rest a whole-figure frame with its own drawn head. No prop.

what.A1: Rest: sitting up behind the table, wings folded forward, wingtips resting on the felt apart, crest burning steadily
what.A2: Peeking: the right wingtip cupped low over its cards, head bent to look
what.A3: Check: the right wingtip taps the felt
what.A4: Call: the right wingtip slides forward along the felt
what.A5: Bet: leans in, the right wingtip pushed well forward
what.A6: Fold: a flick of the right wingtip
what.B1: All in: both wings sweep forward together, crest blazing
what.B2: Show: the right wingtip turns over
what.B3: Big win: wings spread high, crest blazing, a triumphant cry (`win_big`)
what.B4: The flames along its crest flare up, tall and bright
what.B5: A single spark drifts up from its crest (decoy for B4)
what.C1: Shakes a little ash from its feathers (decoy for B6)
what.C2: Its feathers dim to embers, crest low and dark red
what.C3: Turns its head toward the light (decoy for C2)
what.C4: Watches you with one gold eye, head turned side-on
what.C5: Spreads its wings wide, lighting the room (heads-up opener)
what.C6: Sings: beak open, one clear note
what.D1: Talking: a trill, beak a little open
what.D2: Facing a big bet: feathers sleeked flat, perfectly still
what.D3: Lost a pot: feathers ruffled, head tucked a little
what.D4: Crushing loss: head bowed, wings drooping, ash drifting (`lose_big`)
what.D5: Heads up: leaning in, both wingtips forward on the felt
what.D6: Knocked out: burns down, all at once, in a great bright flame

rest.what: its right wingtip on the felt
its left wingtip on the felt
